summary: Planning a 7-day solo Japan trip December 8–15, 2026, departing Raleigh-Durham (RDU), with 7 hotel nights. Hotel budget USD $150–200/night; preferred style upscale boutique. Tokyo-only itinerary with Shibuya as preferred base. Interests: streetwear/sneaker/vintage shopping, Japanese food, nightlife; wakes around 11 AM–12 PM; wants only 1–2 touristy activities. Draft days: arrive/Shibuya; Harajuku/Omotesando/Cat Street; Shimokitazawa vintage; Shibuya sneaker shopping; Asakusa/Senso-ji and Shibuya Sky; Koenji vintage and food; final shopping/food. Flight research: American Airlines advertises exact RDU–Tokyo Dec 8–15 economy round trip from $945 on one listing, while another AA listing displayed $1,099; fare volatile, exact flight times/connection and checkout total not verified. No nonstop RDU–Tokyo flights; compare HND and NRT, favor HND if price similar. Expedia surfaced a nearby United RDU–NRT Dec 9–15 fare at $970, not exact dates. Hotel candidates: sequence MIYASHITA PARK (one-night Dec 8 quote around $170/night/$187 with taxes, 4-star, design-forward, rooftop bar, 3-min walk to Shibuya Metro Exit B1, official 17:00 check-in/14:00 checkout); Shibuya Granbell Hotel (one-night quote around $118/night/$130 with taxes, design-oriented, 3-min walk to Shibuya Station, smaller rooms); Hotel Indigo Tokyo Shibuya (one-night quote around $312/night/$348 with taxes, above budget). These are one-night indicative quotes, not verified seven-night inventory or totals. Recommendation: sequence MIYASHITA PARK if the full 7-night average including taxes remains within $200/night; Granbell as value backup. Estimated overall trip budget $2,655–$3,650 including $300–600 shopping allowance. No bookings made.
